column1: # Custom partition table for v2-M2 — adds a `model` partition for esp-sr's
# srmodels.bin (WakeNet wake-word models). Replaces IDF's built-in
# Layout for the 8 MB flash on ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8:
#   ota_0:    0x190000..0x310000  (1.5 MB) OTA slot 0 (unused for now)
#   ota_1:    0x310000..0x490000  (1.5 MB) OTA slot 1 (unused for now)
#   - App partitions bumped from 1 MB (built-in) to 1.5 MB to absorb esp-sr's
#     ~500 KB of prebuilt-library .text/.rodata. v2-M1 binary was 836 KB; v2-M2
#   - Model partition at 2 MB — wn9_jarvis_tts is ~500-700 KB. 2 MB leaves room
#     to add a second model (e.g. a custom-trained `hi_jarvis`) without

column2: and is the size most esp-skainet examples use.
